calculation.description: Five-day log-return impulse scaled by trailing 20-day daily log-return volatility and lagged one completed trading day to prevent look-ahead. Higher values indicate stronger recent risk-adjusted impulse.

validation.regime_notes: 10-day IC clears the benchmark-wide absolute IC gate narrowly; IC is positive early and late but negative in the middle regime. Results are uncertain in the 15-asset cross-section and signal turnover is relatively high. 20d/40d decay is stronger than 10d.
